text:
Predicates:
Top10(x) ::: x is on the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Company(y) ::: y is a game company.
Japanese(y) ::: y is a Japanese company.
LegendOfZelda ::: the Legend of Zelda.
Premises:
Created(legendOfZelda, companyX) ∧ Game(legendOfZelda) ∧ Company(companyX) ∧ Japanese(companyX) ::: A Japanese game company created the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Game(x) ∧ Created(x, y) ∧ Company(y) ∧ Japanese(y)) → Top10(x) ::: All games created by Japanese game companies are on the Top 10 list.
∀x (SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(x) ∧ Game(x)) → Top10(x) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it is on the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillionCopies(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
Top10(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is on the Top 10 list.
